subject: maths
question: What is the simple interest on ₹8,000 at the yearly rate of interest of 5% for 3(1)/(2) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs.8000

Rate = 5% ; time = (7/2) years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (8000 × 5 × 7)/200

⇒ 40 × 5 × 7 = Rs.1400

**∴ The simple interest**** is Rs.1400.**
